LanguageData.HE_Pars_Pilaf.label: saffron pilaf
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Pilaf.description: A mound of long-grain rice steamed with saffron and butter, topped with barberries, pistachios and a piece of its own golden crust.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kebab.label: kebab and saffron rice
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Kebab.description: Spiced minced meat grilled on flat swords of iron, laid on a mound of saffron rice. Served at every caravan inn.
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Sholeh.label: sholeh zard
LanguageData.HE_Pars_Sholeh.description: A golden rice pudding with saffron, rosewater and pistachios, drawn with a cinnamon pattern on top. Cooked for vows and blessings. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
